package.name: cyton_description
package.description: URDF/xacro description, visual meshes, and ros2_control hardware block for the Cyton Gamma 1500 7-DOF arm. Kinematic geometry (per-joint axis tilt/origin/scale corrections) comes from this project's NDI-based calibration. Visual meshes (meshes/*.dae) are ported from the third-party ROS1 package cyton_gamma_1500_description by Gert Kanter (BSD-licensed, http://wiki.ros.org/cyton_gamma_1500_description); collision geometry is intentionally not yet included (deferred).
